items.body:
赫海威, PABLO ROBLES2026年11月27日

Was Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi of Japan snubbed during China’s big summit?

日本首相高市早苗在中国举办的重要峰会期间是否遭到了冷遇？

That question has dominated the headlines in Japan in recent days, with some officials saying that Beijing intentionally undermined Ms. Takaichi during her visit last week to Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum.

这一问题近几天成为日本的新闻热点，一些官员表示，北京上周在高市早苗访问中国深圳出席亚太经合组织(APEC)论坛期间蓄意怠慢了她。

Japanese commentators drew attention to a sizable drop at the top of the stairs that greeted Ms. Takaichi’s plane, which forced her to descend awkwardly. They noted the lack of cheering crowds at the airport, a gesture that was afforded to other leaders. They pointed out that she was met on the tarmac by a low-ranking official.

日本评论人士指出，迎接高市早苗专机的舷梯顶部存在明显落差，迫使她走下飞机时显得十分狼狈。他们注意到机场没有欢呼的人群，而其他领导人则享有这一礼遇。他们还指出，在停机坪迎接她的是一名级别较低的官员。

The scrutiny comes as relations between the two countries are at a low point. China has been at odds with Japan since last year, when Ms. Takaichi suggested that Japan could be forced to get involved militarily in case of a Chinese attack on Taiwan. Beijing considers Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, part of its territory.

引发这一审视之际，两国关系正处于低谷。自去年高市早苗暗示若中国进攻台湾日本可能被迫进行军事介入以来，中国一直与日本存在摩擦。北京将实行自治民主制度的台湾视为其领土的一部分。

Asked about the pared-down welcome, a spokesman for China’s Foreign Ministry, Guo Jiakun, brushed aside the criticism at a recent news conference in Beijing.

当被问及简化欢迎仪式一事时，中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆近日在北京举行的记者会上对批评不以为然。

“As the host,” he said, “China makes appropriate protocol arrangements for all participants in accordance with international practice.”

“作为东道主，”他说，“中方根据国际惯例，对所有参会方作出适当的礼宾安排。”

The Chinese Foreign Ministry did not respond to a request for comment.

中国外交部未回应置评请求。

Here is a look at how Ms. Takaichi was received in China, compared with other world leaders.

以下是高市早苗在中国所受接待与其他世界领导人的对比情况。

The Stairs

舷梯

Source: Reuters

When Ms. Takaichi arrived in Shenzhen, she faced an immediate problem. There was a drop of roughly 16 inches between her aircraft’s doorway and the boarding stairs. Ms. Takaichi seemed surprised; she gripped the door and proceeded slowly down the first step.

高市早苗抵达深圳时，立刻遇到了一个问题。她的飞机舱门与登机舷梯之间存在约40厘米的落差。高市早苗似乎感到惊讶；她紧紧抓住舱门，缓慢迈下了第一级台阶。

Ms. Takaichi has said in the past that she has rheumatoid arthritis and an artificial joint in her leg. Japanese commentators said the incident posed a safety risk.

高市早苗过去曾表示自己患有类风湿性关节炎，腿部装有人工关节。日本评论人士称，这一事件构成了安全隐患。

“What if the prime minister, who is disembarking in a skirt and high heels, were to lose her footing and get injured?” Yasuhide Nakayama, a lawmaker with the governing Liberal Democratic Party, wrote on social media. “We should demand a proper explanation from the Chinese side regarding the installation of the gangway and the safety checks.”

“穿着裙子和高跟鞋下飞机的首相如果踩空受伤怎么办？”执政党自民党议员中山泰秀在社交媒体上写道。“我们应该要求中方就舷梯的安装及安全检查作出合理解释。”

Still, some officials said it was unclear whether the discrepancy was purposeful, and that it could have been a simple malfunction.

不过，一些官员表示，尚不清楚这一落差是否为有意为之，并表示可能仅仅是一次普通的设备故障。

Koichi Hagiuda, an L.D.P. official, said at a news conference this week: “I believe that the host nation, China, did not intend to be disrespectful. It was likely an unforeseen, spontaneous occurrence.”

自民党官员萩生田光一本周在记者会上表示：“我认为东道主中国并非有意失礼。这很可能是一起无法预见的突发事件。”

The Crowds

人群China put on the pomp and circumstance for visiting leaders. President Trump, President Lee Jae​ Myung of South Korea and Vietnam’s leader, To Lam, were greeted on the tarmac by boisterous crowds, dancers, bouquets and a flowing red carpet.

中国为来访领导人安排了隆重的欢迎仪式。美国总统特朗普、韩国总统李在明以及越南领导人苏林在停机坪上受到了欢呼的人群、舞者、花束和红地毯的迎接。

But for Ms. Takaichi the crowds were gone, and there was no cheering, dancing or red carpet.

但到了高市早苗这里，人群不见了，也没有欢呼、舞蹈或红地毯。

Akio Takahara, a visiting professor at Tokyo Woman’s Christian University who specializes in Chinese politics, said the reception showed that “some in China wanted to tell Takaichi that they didn’t like her and that she’s not welcomed.”

专攻中国政治的东京女子大学访问教授高原明生表示，这一接待表明“中国国内有些人想告诉高市，他们不喜欢她，也不欢迎她”。

“Japan-China relations are a bit like U.S.-Europe relations: Both sides harbor a psychological complex toward the other side,” he said. “The Chinese — although they are objectively bigger and stronger than Japan — they still aren’t confident enough to get over this complex.”

“日中关系有点像美欧关系：双方都对彼此抱有一种心理情结，”他说。“中国人——尽管客观上比日本更庞大、更强大——仍然没有足够的自信来克服这种情结。”

China’s Foreign Ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

中国外交部未立即回应置评请求。

The Greeter

接机官员

Source: Reuters

China is known to choreograph every detail of major summits. So it was striking, analysts said, that the government dispatched a relatively low-level official, Zhang Qiyue, a retired Chinese ambassador to Greece, to welcome Ms. Takaichi on the tarmac.

中国向来以精心编排重大峰会的每一个细节而闻名。因此，分析人士指出，中国政府派出级别相对较低的官员——退休的中国前驻希腊大使章启月——在停机坪迎接高市早苗，显得格外引人注目。

By contrast Xi Jinping was there in person to accept a hug from Mr. Trump, the first time Mr. Xi had personally received a foreign dignitary at the airport as China’s leader. Vladimir V. Putin was met by Cai Qi, a trusted deputy of Mr. Xi’s and one of the most influential members of the Chinese leader’s circle. And Mr. Lee was greeted by a senior official from the Chinese province of Guangdong.

相比之下，习近平亲自到场接受了特朗普的拥抱，这是习近平作为中国领导人首次到机场迎接外国政要。弗拉基米尔·V·普京则由习近平信任的副手、中国领导人核心圈最具影响力的成员之一蔡奇迎接。李在明由中国广东省的一名高级官员迎接。

Still, as the APEC meeting got underway, Ms. Takaichi seemed keen to move on. She enthusiastically greeted Mr. Xi at a banquet a few hours later. The two shook hands briefly and posed for photos, their first encounter since the start of the diplomatic feud over Taiwan. They repeated the routine the next morning. After the forum concluded, Ms. Takaichi returned to the airport in Shenzhen, boarded her plane and headed back to Tokyo.

不过，随着APEC会议拉开帷幕，高市早苗似乎急于翻过这一页。几小时后，她在晚宴上热情地向习近平致意。两人简短握手并合影留念，这是自围绕台湾问题爆发外交争端以来两人的首次会面。次日上午，两人重复了这一礼节。论坛结束后，高市早苗返回深圳机场，登上专机飞回东京。

Hisako Ueno自东京、Berry Wang自香港、Keith Bradsher自北京对本文有报道贡献。

赫海威(Javier C. Hernández)是《纽约时报》东京分社社长，领导时报对日本及周边地区的报道。在过去十年的大部分时间里，他一直在亚洲进行报道，此前曾任驻华记者。

items.body:
ADAM SATARIANO, 孟建国2026年11月27日

Nvidia has halted some sales of its most advanced A.I. chips to four countries in Southeast Asia as the Trump administration intensifies efforts to cut Chinese companies off from American computing power.

随着特朗普政府进一步加紧切断中国企业获取美国算力的渠道，英伟达已暂停向东南亚四国销售部分最先进人工智能芯片。

Data center operators in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia have had orders put on hold, according to two people with knowledge of the sales suspension, who spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss private business dealings.

据两名此次销售暂停情况的知情人士透露，马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚的数据中心运营商已有订单被搁置。因涉及非公开的商业往来，这两名人士要求匿名。

The freeze threatens one of the world’s fastest-growing data center markets, where billions of dollars of projects are under construction. Much of the region’s growth has been fueled by Chinese companies renting access to powerful Nvidia chips that American export controls prohibit them from purchasing directly.

这一冻结措施威胁到全球增长最快的数据中心市场之一，该地区目前有价值数十亿美元的项目正在建设中。这种增长很大程度上由中国企业推动，它们通过租赁方式使用高性能的英伟达芯片，而美国出口管制禁止它们直接购买这些芯片。

Nvidia did not provide immediate comment.

英伟达未立即置评。

The U.S. Commerce Department last week proposed new measures aimed at closing that loophole. Under the new policy, which is still under review, data center operators in several Southeast Asian countries would be required to obtain licenses to acquire Nvidia’s most advanced chips if they supply “significant volumes of computing power” to companies headquartered in a handful of countries deemed high-risk, including China, Russia and Iran.

美国商务部上周提出了旨在堵住这一漏洞的新措施。根据这项仍在审查中的新政策，如果东南亚数个国家的数据中心运营商向总部位于中国、俄罗斯和伊朗等少数被视为高风险国家的企业提供“大量算力”，就必须获得许可证才能采购英伟达最先进的芯片。

The measures extend Washington’s efforts to restrict China’s technological development, targeting both its ability to acquire advanced American chips and its ability to use them overseas.

这些措施延伸了华盛顿限制中国技术发展的举措，既针对中国获取美国先进芯片的能力，也针对其在海外使用这些芯片的能力。

Southeast Asia has become a lucrative market for Nvidia, which has sold billions of dollars worth of chips to data center operators in the region. Many of those companies, known as “neoclouds,” specialize in renting out computing power to other customers. For years, that arrangement has allowed Chinese companies to access some of the world’s most advanced computing infrastructure without owning the chips themselves.

多年来，这种安排使中国企业无需自己拥有芯片，即可使用全球最先进的计算基础设施。

items.body:
郑爽遭封杀逾五年 罕谈代孕落泪

女星郑爽2021年卷入代孕及税务风波后淡出荧幕。定居美国的她，不时在社媒分享近况。她26日上传一段独白视频，罕见谈及当年选择代孕时的心情，说自己当时觉得应该有孩子，却又对建立亲密关系感到害怕。她说到一半落泪，“我怕他依赖我，我怕我依赖他，又怕有一天这种感情突然间不存在了……”

郑爽在帖文中透露，前阵子看完一场演唱会后，心情莫名沉重，于是录下几段独白，这次先公开其中一段。她坦言，自己一直害怕对人或事物产生太深的感情，也常提醒自己“不该拥有”，“我觉得自己这一生要学会爱，学会接受爱，学习的课程很多。”她也说，如果粉丝不喜欢这类视频，可以直接告诉她，她就不再发布。

郑爽在视频中谈及当年对亲子关系的顾虑，引来一些网民留言询问两名孩子的近况。

现年35岁的郑爽与前男友张恒在2019年底分手，随后扯出借贷纠纷，女方向男方追讨2000万人民币；2021年1月，张恒发文澄清外界传闻，文中提及“两个小生命”，两人此前在美国秘婚，并通过代孕生下一儿一女的消息随之曝光。郑爽当时被指曾考虑终止妊娠，并在得知已无法终止妊娠后提出送养。

代孕风波后，郑爽被中国官方点名为“劣迹艺人”，随后又因逃漏税遭处罚，演艺事业停摆，已拍摄的作品也未能播出。她否认弃养，并与张恒在美国就孩子的监护权对簿公堂。最终，孩子由张恒单独抚养，郑爽每周可探视数小时。

items.body:
SOUMYA KARLAMANGLA2026年11月26日

今年9月，乔纳森·麦金西在都柏林体育场的停车场遭枪击身亡。 Sarah Dussault/Bay Area News Group, via Associated Press

On a warm Saturday afternoon this fall, Jonathan McKinsey had just finished playing with his three children at a Bay Area park. He dragged a wagon past a baseball diamond and crowded playground and began to load items into the trunk of his SUV.

今年秋天一个温暖的周六下午，乔纳森·麦金西刚在湾区一个公园里和三个孩子结束玩耍。他拉着一辆小拖车经过棒球场和拥挤的游乐场，开始把东西装进SUV后备箱。

Then a bullet struck the back of his head, prosecutors say. Within 40 seconds, at least 17 more rounds were fired at Mr. McKinsey.

检察官说，随后一颗子弹击中了他的后脑勺。在40秒内，至少又有17发子弹射向麦金西。

It was shocking enough that Mr. McKinsey was shot repeatedly in a park filled with children in Dublin, Calif., a Bay Area suburb popular among tech workers.

麦金西在加利福尼亚州都柏林市一座满是儿童的公园里遭到多次枪击，本身就已经令人震惊。都柏林是旧金山湾区一座深受科技行业从业者青睐的郊区城市。

But the killing, on Sept. 26, reverberated far beyond Northern California after the authorities said the assailants were Mr. McKinsey’s 77-year-old in-laws. And headlines all over the world noted Mr. McKinsey’s role as director of engineering for the department at The New York Times that produces Wordle and other games.

而在当局称行凶者是麦金西77岁的岳父母后，这起发生在9月26日的凶杀案引起的震动远远超出了北加州。世界各地的新闻报道纷纷提到，麦金西是《纽约时报》负责开发Wordle等游戏的部门的工程总监。

Prosecutors say that the in-laws, Shouyong Zhang and Shili Chen, jointly carried out a murder plot amid contentious divorce proceedings and a custody battle between Mr. McKinsey and their daughter, Candice Jang. Mr. McKinsey had been married to Ms. Jang for 15 years and had three children with her before they were recently separated.

检方称，在麦金西与妻子坎迪斯·张陷入激烈的离婚诉讼和子女监护权争夺战之际，女方父母张守勇（音）和陈诗丽（音）共同实施了这起谋杀。麦金西与坎迪斯·张结婚15年，育有三个孩子，两人不久前分居。

Defense lawyers have not disputed that the couple shot Mr. McKinsey, but say that they did so out of fear for their safety as well as the safety of their daughter and grandchildren. They cite child abuse allegations against Mr. McKinsey as well as the ongoing family court proceedings.

辩护律师没有否认这对夫妇枪杀了麦金西，但表示他们这样做是出于对自己以及女儿和孙辈安全的担忧。律师援引了有关麦金西虐待儿童的指控，以及仍在进行中的家事法庭诉讼。

“The larger court record is replete with facts supporting both self-defense and defense of others,” Amy Cheng, a deputy public defender who represents Mr. Zhang, said in a recent filing.

“从更广泛的法庭记录来看，有大量事实可以为自卫和保护他人免受侵害的辩护主张提供依据，”代理张守勇的公设辩护人办公室的副辩护律师艾米·程在最近提交的一份法庭文件中说。

The details of the allegations are laid out in court documents that have been unsealed or filed in recent weeks. Mr. Zhang, Ms. Chen and their lawyers could not be reached for comment. 目前尚不清楚坎迪斯·张是否知道父母的计划，以及如果知情其了解程度如何。调查人员已经搜查了她的住所，但她尚未受到任何刑事指控。记者通过电话联系到她时，她拒绝接受采访。
On a recorded jail-line call between Ms. Jang and Ms. Chen, Ms. Chen asked her daughter to return the rental car so that it didn’t accumulate late fees, according to Mr. Briggs’ court filings.
根据布里格斯提交的法庭文件，在母女通过羁押地点的电话系统进行的一次有录音记录的通话中，陈诗丽让女儿归还租来的车，以免产生滞纳金。
She told her repeatedly to take good care of the children. And, according to the filings, she apologized for “all the stress I’m causing you.”
她一再叮嘱女儿要照顾好孩子。根据法庭文件，她还因为“给你造成了这么多压力”向女儿道歉。
